descriptor.name: City of Hamilton Assessment Parcel
descriptor.scope: City of Hamilton assessment parcel mapping from Teranet; bounded technical review only.
descriptor.attribution: City of Hamilton; Teranet data received February 9, 2024.

evidence: Frozen Hamilton packet and live first-party item https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/content/items/b18cec4690d241029935df1b02bb19db?f=json identify the City of Hamilton assessment parcel polygon service, sourced from Teranet on February 9, 2024; item extent contains the unchanged Hamilton point.

Producer purpose corroboration: https://teranetcommercialsolutions.zendesk.com/hc/en-ca/articles/360001563451-What-do-the-different-colour-boundaries-represent-on-the-map explains assessment parcels as boundaries based on MPAC legal land descriptions; municipal Teranet PARCEL_ASSESSMENT explanation at https://services.arcgis.com/rYz782eMbySr2srL/ArcGIS/rest/services/Municipal_Land_Disposition_Parcels/FeatureServer states assessment mapping maps assessable parcels. See evidence/source-purpose.json.
